Chapter 6421: I Spare The Heaven

Chapter 6421: I Spare The Heaven

The gap between Ocean-gaze and Heavenly Crane was considerable. The former was at the heaven stage while the latter had reached the unequaled stage, one level higher.

Most importantly, his soul had fused into Immortal-seek Peak. Remember, a stone removed from this place had turned into a supreme overlord before.

Thus, it was a wondrous fortune. Although he couldn’t leave the peak, it made him grow stronger.

“Bam!” It left a large hole in the barrier despite the defenders’ best efforts. Moreover, it continued to pierce through the ocean and left behind a terrible chasm.

“Feast.” Heavenly Crane gave the order.

“Attack!” Nine-cries, Ravenous Wolf God, and Ghost-sparrow jumped into the alliance.

“Me too!” Heavenpray Monarch roared and sent down lightning bolts all over Imperial Alliance.

“Tighten!” Ocean-gaze focused the grand formation into a single spot to deal with Heavenly Crane.

The others weren’t a threat as long as he could stop Heavenly Crane.

“Formation!” The other emperors didn’t wish to fight directly and connected their formations instead, forming a great sword to pierce the invaders.

On the other hand, the invaders had no teamwork and fought as individuals.

“Let’s see what you can do!” Nine-cries conjured a domain of death. Countless specters descended to spread the rotting process to every inch of Imperial League.

“Burn!” Ghost-sparrow unleashed the inferno to incite everyone’s desires. Weaker cultivators would start burning just from looking at it.

“Devour!” Ravenous Wolf God opened his mouth and spat out stars. They wrapped around other entities and swallowed them whole. Mountains and rivers weren’t spared.

The defenders were ready for this the moment they saw Isles of Evil looming above.

Virtuoso played the zither and summoned a sword domain to stop the incoming attacks. Thousand-eyed Emperor used her special technique with the help of other emperors - turning time into a palace.

When this palace opened, it released a flood of true chaos energy toward the invaders.

“He’s mine!” Nine-cries was furious and grew larger, wanting to fight Virtuoso one-on-one.

Meanwhile, his allies focused on the energy palace. However, two more combatants joined the fight.

“Luosha’s Wheel!” One was a heaven-slayer taking control of the battlefield’s numerous affinities and twisting them into a wheel.

“I spare the heaven!” Someone roared and threw a golden saber up into the air.

“Clank!” The man’s grand dao and the saber became one as it returned for a slash at the enemy instead of the sky.

“Luosha and Goldblade!” Members of Imperial League were horrified.

They could stop the current attackers but not when these two were involved.

“Wait?!” Nine-cries’ group shouted because the attacks came for them.

“Death Screech!” Nine-cries’ wings flapped and created a death domain. Countless specters floated before him to stop the attack.

However, the wheel cut through the hellish domain and the specters.

“Splash!” Blood splashed as he was cut in half.

“Sea of Desires!” Ghost-sparrow reacted by turning his eyes into two seas to stop the returning saber.

“Star Shield!” Ravenous Wolf God assumed a defensive stance, forming a colossal shield to block the blade from behind.

“Clank!” They were occupied with Thousand-eyed’s palace and had no time to stop the ambush, losing their head as a result.

Heavenpray was weaker and didn’t have the chance to fight back. All of his lightning bolts were coming toward Thousand-eyed’s group so he lost his head.

The defenders found this puzzling since the villains attacked their own.
